The '''Armand Isard Correction Facility''' was a civilian [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] through the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

==Description==
The facility was an example of early [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] architecture, built of black [[Synthstone/Legends|synthstone]]. It was a tall, single building surrounded by an exercise yard, which was in turn surrounded by a fifteen-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] wall. In each corner stood a tower with nests for [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], as well as powerful spotlights.

==History==
{{Quote|Bureaucratic inertia has kept it from being renamed. Or repainted. Or torn down.|Jaina Solo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
The [[Prison/Legends|prison]] was named after [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], the first [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]]. According to [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], the prison was named by [[Ysanne Isard]], who succeeded her father as head of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. This was not done out of regret, but rather out of a malevolent sense of humor.

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|captured]] Coruscant in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]], the facility kept its original name, despite its connection to the old regime. It would later survive a number of successive invasions, and the [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

[[Valin Horn]] was taken to the Armand Isard Correction Facility in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], after his encasement in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

An [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|unsuccessful raid]] took place here by [[Seff Hellin]], who suffered from the same [[Force psychosis|ailment]] as Horn, in an attempt to free Horn. However, the raid resulted in Hellin's capture by [[Darkmeld]].
